text: I have never tried a more realistic Vegetarian “chicken wing” in my life. I asked my friend group and everyone was impressed at how close the taste & texture of the vegetarian strips to the original ones.

There were no seats, so we had to stand throughout those 2 hours. Requesting a takeaway order was fast, but waiting to receive one takes ages.
